Consuming large amounts of alcohol can cause your body to excrete potassium in the urine. This can lead to decreased potassium levels in your bloodstream.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"ezoic-autoinsert-ad ezoic-under_first_paragraph\" face=\"system, BlinkMacSystemFont, -apple-system, \u0026quot;.SFNSText-Regular\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;San Francisco\u0026quot;, Roboto, \u0026quot;Segoe UI\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;Helvetica Neue\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;Lucida Grande\u0026quot;, sans-serif\" style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; border: 0px; box-sizing: inherit; caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: black; font-size: 18px; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; vertical-align: baseline;\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: auto; border: 0px; box-sizing: inherit; caret-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); color: black; font-family: system, BlinkMacSystemFont, -apple-system, \u0026quot;.SFNSText-Regular\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;San Francisco\u0026quot;, Roboto, \u0026quot;Segoe UI\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;Helvetica Neue\u0026quot;, \u0026quot;Lucida Grande\u0026quot;, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: calc(18px + var(--mv-trellis-gutter-small,10px)); margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 0px; margin-top: 0px; padding: 0px; vertical-align: baseline;\"\u003EFurthermore, drinking excessive amounts of alcohol can cause dehydration which can cause the levels of potassium in your body to become dangerously low.
